Signed documentation to increase stake in Candere and convert it to a wholly-owned subsidiary; Candere added 13 showrooms in FY25 so far out of targeted 50.
Plan to convert four Middle East showrooms to franchise in Q2 FY25 and use proceeds to reduce regional debt; first US showroom expected before Diwali.
Opened 5 Kalyan and 2 Candere showrooms in July; on track to launch 35 more Kalyan and 20 more Candere showrooms before Diwali.
Revenue per showroom declining as franchisee stores (INR 50 cr revenue/store) dilute owned store average (INR 90+ cr); trend to continue as more franchise stores added.
Franchisee capex model: first 30-35 of 80 FY25 showrooms funded by Kalyan, rest by franchisees; franchise model adds ~0.25% gross margin increment.
Two new procurement centers opened in Bihar and UP with minimal capex; focused on artisan/vendor network integration rather than capital investment.
Middle East FOCO showrooms reduce gross margins vs owned stores; finance cost pressure from rising rates to ease as conversions proceed and rate base normalizes.
No formal revenue guidance for FY25-26; targeting SSSG and revenue growth in current range supported by 80 store expansion plan and stronger July SSSG.
Confident of full-year margin expansion despite Q1 miss; will reassess in 2 quarters; Q2 operating leverage expected to improve with revenue growth.
